obligor_name: Front Porch Communities and Services (pre-merger entity at 2019-12-31)
_communities_note: At 2019-12-31, Front Porch operated ~11 communities. Covia communities (Webster House, Los Gatos Meadows, San Francisco Towers, St. Paul's Towers Oakland, Spring Lake Village split, Canterbury Woods, Bay-area Covia) were SEPARATE — joined via Apr 2021 affiliation, merger completed March 2022.
_structural_note: Front Porch in 2019 was a standalone obligor rated 'A' by Fitch. Covia (separately rated A- by Fitch) was a separate CA CCRC obligor. They announced affiliation June 2020, effective April 1 2021, with full merger completed March 31, 2022. The current combined Front Porch obligor is post-merger.
